notes: Signing out now takes you back to the login screen. In 0.4.15 it did erase your saved session and credentials, but the app that reopened crashed on startup with a "Failed to execute script 'main'" error and closed instead: the new instance was reusing the temporary folder the old one was deleting. It now starts as a genuinely new instance.
notas: Sair da conta agora devolve você à tela de login. Na 0.4.15 a sessão e as credenciais salvas eram apagadas de verdade, mas o app que reabria quebrava no arranque com "Failed to execute script 'main'" e fechava: a instância nova reaproveitava a pasta temporária que a antiga estava apagando. Agora ela sobe como uma instância realmente nova.
